Elaine Park: quick sync — post-partner call update: Acme is saying Enterprise RBAC + signed audit logs are blocking for their launch. They asked to move those into our next milestone. We need a call on what we can realistically commit to without derailing the timeline.
Mike Huang: noted. rough calc: RBAC + audit logs is ~2.5 sprints work (eng + infra). If we bundle it in, launch slips ~3 weeks.
Raj Patel: eng view: RBAC has 3 parts: auth model, policy enforcement, mgmt UI. Audit logs need log ingestion + retention + signed integrity checks. The heavy lift is infra (storage+signing) not the UI.
Anna Gomez: design: we can do a very small UI for RBAC (roles + invite flow) that looks complete but defers advanced policy DSL. Minimal UX cuts effort.
Chloe Rivera: from CS: Acme said it's blocking unless they can self-serve role mappings and see tamper-proof logs. They're a strategic pilot, risk of pausing if not included.
Jake Wu: data/telemetry: we can ship basic signed logs using existing blob store + HMAC signing in ~1 sprint if we accept reduced queryability (no fancy index). Full audit search would add another sprint.
Mike Huang: proposal: split into "commit" vs "deferred" for next milestone. Commit = core RBAC (auth model + enforcement) + basic signed append-only logs (read via S3). Defer = policy DSL, advanced log search, policy UI polish — move to v1.
Elaine Park: that's a good starting point. Need clear acceptance criteria so sales/customer teams can signal to Acme. Can we draft gating checklist now?
Raj Patel: draft acceptance criteria (minimal):
```
- RBAC enforcement active for Dedicated and Hosted (config flag)
- Create/manage roles + assign users via simple UI
- Signed append-only audit logs delivered to customer-managed bucket
- End-to-end test demonstrating tamper-proof log signature
- SLO: any RBAC check latency < 8ms p50
```
Anna Gomez: UI acceptance: role CRUD + invite + simple error states. No fancy bulk-mapping.
Chloe Rivera: product acceptance: CS confirms Acme will accept S3-based logs if we ship a howto + retention doc. If yes, risk goes down.
Mike Huang: risks: 1) infra ops time to support customer-managed buckets 2) gating feature parity for Hosted customers 3) timeline slippage — mitigation: canary to Dedicated first, then Hosted after 2-week soak.
Elaine Park: decision needed today: PR for scope + updated milestone dates. Action items: Mike to update roadmap, Raj to create work breakdown, Anna to mock minimal UI, Chloe to confirm Acme acceptability, Jake to prototype HMAC signing. Owner list and due dates?
Mike Huang: I'll update roadmap by EOD and schedule a 30m triage at 10:30am PT. Owners: Raj (eng lead), Anna (design), Jake (telemetry), Chloe (CS).
Raj Patel: I'll drop a WIP ticket list in eng channel and mark dependencies.
Chloe Rivera: I'll ping Acme now and loop back before triage.
ops-bot: Reminder: "Roadmap sync" scheduled 10:30am PT today (added by Mike Huang).
Elaine Park: OK. If we agree at triage, plan = include minimal RBAC + signed logs in milestone, defer advanced features to v1. Quick thumbs? :thumbsup: :eyes:
